features.description: High matrix_pin disposition eligibility after repeated full clearance, via a dedicated confirmation-required disposition kind; critical and plan_contract remain absolute blocks.
features.acceptance: convergence_verdict gains a streak-gated eligibility rule: a HIGH-severity finding whose auditor-emitted class is matrix_pin becomes disposition-eligible IFF the ledger contains at least N consecutive full-clearance audit rounds ending at the current round (N configurable, default 2); eligibility NEVER applies to critical severity, to plan_contract class, or to conservative-fallback classifications. Eligible highs are dispositioned ONLY with a new waived_matrix_pin_high kind that REQUIRES explicit operator confirmation text (>= 20 chars), is recorded/mirrored/invalidated exactly like existing kinds, and counts as a no-audit kind for the resolution path. The refusal message names the streak-unlocked eligibility when it applies. The exhaustive severity x class matrix test is updated for the streak-conditional cell. Fixtures replay C0 ledger rounds 1-3 (real auditor-emitted classes from sufficiency-rounds.jsonl) asserting round 3's high matrix_pin is eligible under the streak while rounds 1-2 are not, plus the nine prior fixture rounds remain verdict-stable. Zero live auditor calls in tests.
